session-fork.discussTheCompletedTurnWith: Discuss the completed turn with the same account and settings. Sidechat reads the parent's current workspace and keeps its own conversation. Parent cleanup or permanent deletion also permanently deletes dependent Sidechats after their work stops.
session-fork.theChildKeepsASeparateCopy_: The child keeps a separate copy of this conversation and its General Chat files.
session-fork.sourceMessagesStayInTheirOr: Source messages stay in their original session; the new native conversation retains that context.
session-fork.createAnIndependentConversa: Create an independent conversation from <s0/> at its completed turn, using the same computer, account and settings. <s1/>
session-fork.sidechatStartsPausedWithNat: Sidechat starts paused with native read-only permissions. Add a message and Resume; explicitly select replies to send to the parent queue.
session-fork.opencodeForksSupportComplet: OpenCode forks support completed plain-text General Chat on macOS and Linux. The child starts paused; add a new message and Resume when ready.
session-fork.independentProjectWorkspace: Independent project workspaces copy every repository's current commit and files. Local sharing is available for user-owned Local checkouts and requires proof from this computer's Worker.
session-fork.theSourceChangedCloseAndDis: The source changed. Close and discard this draft, then inspect the current turn before another fork.
session-fork.theChildAppearsAfterNativeH: The child appears after native history, every workspace and process cleanup are verified.
session-fork.theForkAcknowledgmentIsInco: The fork acknowledgment is incomplete. Retain the original request and inspect its operation before another fork.
